title: Practice 1: Irregular comparatives: лучше, больше, старше

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: She gradually moved closer to him.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The laws are now more strictly enforced.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Sulfuric acid is stronger than acetic acid.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Аутоиммунными заболеваниями ___ (частый) страдают женщины, чем мужчины.
exercises.prompt: More women than men suffer from autoimmune diseases.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Письма от Фионы приходили всё ___ (редкий) и реже.
exercises.prompt: Fiona's letters were becoming less and less frequent.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Талая вода, полученная изо льда, не ___ (чистый), чем другие виды воды.
exercises.prompt: Glacial meltwater is not purer than other types of water.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Oranges are sweeter than lemons.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: He's a bit younger than me.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Coastal regions generally have milder climates.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Hey, Ayako! Please speak more loudly.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Yeah, fat chance!
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: I wish I were taller.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: You look like death.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Sirius is a star even brighter than the Sun.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Roll the dough out thin.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Форум заполнен бесконечными спорами на тему, какой игрок ___ (крутой) или какая победа была сильнее.
exercises.prompt: The board is filled with endless debates on which player is greater, or which win was stronger.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Потому, кто может ___ (заранний) определить, на какой он остров попасть может?
exercises.prompt: *Михаил Салтыков-Щедрин, «Помпадуры и помпадурши»*
exercises.why: From Михаил Салтыков-Щедрин, «Помпадуры и помпадурши».

exercises.q: Закрытые глаза слегка ввалились и еще ___ (резкий) оттенились синевой.
exercises.prompt: *Владимир Короленко, «В дурном обществе»*
exercises.why: From Владимир Короленко, «В дурном обществе».

exercises.q: Какие уж ___ (нонкий) желуди, ползаешь-ползаешь по балкам — хоть четверточку наберу.
exercises.prompt: *Иван Шмелёв, «Солнце мёртвых»*
exercises.why: From Иван Шмелёв, «Солнце мёртвых».

exercises.q: Другая ___ (низкий), в малиновом платье с светлыми пуговицами.
exercises.prompt: *Пётр Боборыкин, «Китай-город»*
exercises.why: From Пётр Боборыкин, «Китай-город».
